[Intro]
[F#m]  [C#]
[D]
[A]  [Bm]
[F#m]
[C#]
[D]
[A]  [Bm]
[F#m]

[Verse 1]
[F#m]When I was a child, [A]I hear-
[D]d voices...
[Bm]Some would [D]sing and some would scream
[C#]
[F#m]You soon find you [A]have
[D]few choices...
[Bm]I learned the [C#]voices died with
[F#m]me
[F#m]When I was a child I'd [A]sit fo-
[D]r hours
[Bm]Staring [D]into open flame
[C#]
[F#m]Something in it [A]had a
[D]power
[Bm]Could barely [C#]tear my eyes
[F#m]away

[Chorus]
[F#m]All you have is your
[D]fire... [F#m]
And the place you need to reach
[C#]
[F#m]Don't you [A]ever,
[D]tame your [F#m]demon
But always [C#]keep 'em on a leash
[F#m]

[Interlude]
[F#m]  [C#]
[D]
[A]  [Bm]
[F#m]

[Verse 2]
[F#m]When I was sixteen my [A]senses
[D]fooled me
[Bm]Thought gasoline [D]was on my cloth-
[C#]es
[F#m]I knew that something would [A]always
[D]rule me...
[Bm]I knew the scent [C#]was mine alone
[F#m]

[Chorus]
[F#m]All you have is your
[D]fire... [F#m]
And the place you need to reach
[C#]
[F#m]Don't you [A]ever,
[D]tame your [F#m]demon
Always [C#]keep 'em on a leash
[F#m]

[Bridge]
[F#m]When I was a man [C#]I thought it en-
[D]ded
[A]When I [Bm]knew loves perfect
[F#m]ache
But my peace has [C#]always depen-
[D]ded
[A]On all the [Bm]ashes in my way
[F#m]

[Chorus]
[F#m]All you have is your
[D]fire... [F#m]
And the place you need to reach
[C#]
[F#m]Don't you [A]ever,
[D]tame your [F#m]demon
But always [C#]keep 'em on a leash
[F#m]
title: Arsonist's Lullaby
tuning: E A D G B E
